review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on role focused on building, maintaining, and improving secure, scalable infrastructure across cloud and on-premises environments . Required Skills & Experience 3–5 years of experience in Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Network Engineering, DevOps, or a related role Hands-on experience with AWS, including services such as EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, IAM, and Route 53 Experience administering Linux and/or Windows Server environments Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, firewalls, load balancing, VPCs, and subnets Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation Experience with Docker and Kubernetes Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK Understanding of IAM/S
